question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Filled with fear or dread
solution:
The correct answer is: **Tremulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"filled with fear or dread"** means experiencing intense fear or apprehension. (डर या भय से भरा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **filled with fear or dread** when she heard footsteps behind her in the dark alley.
 
 
 
• **"Tremulous"** refers to something that is shaking or quivering slightly due to fear, nervousness, or weakness. (कांपता हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **His **tremulous **voice revealed his anxiety as he began his speech.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct one word substitute is Tremulous.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prudent** (सावधान): Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.

 
 
• **Example:** It is always **prudent **to save some money for emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Hysterical** (उन्मत्त): Affected by uncontrolled extreme emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** She became **hysterical **when she couldn't find her child in the crowd.
 
 
 
• **Corpulent** (मोटा): Excessively fat.
 
 
• **Example:** The **corpulent **man struggled to fit into the small chair.
